tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The results show elevated creatinine, total bilirubin, and alkaline phosphatase, with low glucose, total protein, carbon dioxide, and AST. These findings suggest impaired renal function and possible cholestatic liver dysfunction. The low glucose and protein may indicate metabolic or nutritional issues. Correlation with clinical findings and further evaluation of liver and kidney function are recommended.
